# Quality and operations checklist: shared F13 requirements

**Purpose**: Review clarity, measurability and consistency of quality, protection and recovery requirements before functional acceptance.

**Created**: 2026-09-17

**Feature**: [Shared quality and operations specification](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the official `speckit-checklist` skill for the approved scope.

**Review ownership**: The reviewer determines whether each requirements-quality criterion is satisfied and may then mark it `[x]`.

**Marker meaning**: `[x]` means the requirement wording has been reviewed and found satisfactory, not that implementation is complete.

## Completeness and measurability

- [ ] CHK001 Are workload/concurrency objectives removed from requirements and roadmap rather than deferred? [Scope, FR-001, A01]
- [ ] CHK002 Are load tests, benchmarks and capacity studies absent from release gates? [Scope, FR-002, SC-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the withdrawn numerical latency target distinguished from ordinary correct responses and bounded waits? [Clarity, FR-003, FR-008]
- [ ] CHK004 Do accepted changes reach their views while current restrictions apply, without a global propagation stopwatch or continuous refresh? [Clarity, FR-004–FR-005, A02]
- [ ] CHK005 Is monthly availability accounting removed while actual incident detection remains required? [Scope, FR-006–FR-010, A04–A05]

## Consistency and operations

- [ ] CHK006 Are actionable diagnostics and manual intervention retained without a human response-time guarantee or on-call duty? [Consistency, FR-010–FR-011, A05]
- [ ] CHK007 Do distinctions between provider observation, acquisition, integration and propagation preserve F01 cadences and thresholds? [Consistency, Specification §FR-005, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK008 Are detection and alerting for VPS loss defined without exclusive dependence on that VPS or selection of a provider? [Completeness, Specification §FR-009–FR-010, §A05]
- [ ] CHK009 Are scoped incidents, partial successes, pauses and recoveries distinguished, with grouping and no repeated notifications? [Coverage, Specification §FR-010–FR-012, §A06–A07]
- [ ] CHK010 Are diagnostic information and user-facing errors bounded, without secrets, personal data or log retention inferred from backups? [Consistency, Specification §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK011 Do recovery instructions define prerequisites, permissions, limits and outcome criteria without treating an accepted command as recovery? [Completeness, Specification §FR-014, §A07, §A18]

## Security and partial processing

- [ ] CHK012 Are rights required for the action and resource regardless of the interface, with no-effect refusals and Pro tolerances assigned to F09? [Completeness, Specification §FR-015, §FR-017–FR-018, §A08]
- [ ] CHK013 Do account changes, delayed responses and retries after sign-in have rules preventing cross-session leaks? [Coverage, Specification §FR-016, §A09]
- [ ] CHK014 Are ordinary duplicate prevention and domain-specific exceptional delivery limits distinguished, with rereading or manual resolution and no universal recovery protocol? [Clarity, FR-008, FR-019, A10]
- [ ] CHK015 Does reconstruction preserve usable results, prohibit fabricated completeness and apply current restrictions? [Consistency, Specification §FR-020, §A12]
- [ ] CHK016 Do normal reruns/manual corrections preserve accepted data and restrictions without requiring fine-grained crash resumption? [Coverage, FR-019–FR-021, A11–A13]

## Protection and restoration

- [ ] CHK017 Is the initial 30-minute backup schedule distinguished from actual recoverable scope and from a guaranteed loss bound, with no separate four-hour collected-data objective? [Measurability, FR-022, A14]
- [ ] CHK018 Are copy independence, 30-day retention and preservation of the last usable copy explicit? [Completeness, Specification §FR-023, §A15–A16]
- [ ] CHK019 Does protection of files and their associations cover deletion/replacement, retention and consistency with restored state, without confusing a URL, S3 and a backup? [Coverage, Specification §FR-024, §A14–A16]
- [ ] CHK020 Are native job failure notifications/history and the silent-stoppage limitation explicit without an absence threshold or supervisor? [Coverage, FR-025, A15]
- [ ] CHK021 Does the prelaunch restoration exercise specify isolation, loss of original storage, data/files, discrepancies and measured duration without a guaranteed deadline? [Measurability, Specification §FR-026, §A16]
- [ ] CHK022 Does restoration apply current erasure and rights obligations before making data available again, with suspension if they are not established? [Consistency, Specification §FR-027, §A17]
- [ ] CHK023 Is application rollback distinct from data restoration, with required compatibility and V2 recovery after opening under F14 without a mandatory functional return to V1? [Clarity, Specification §FR-028, §A18]

## Platforms and continuity

- [ ] CHK024 Are platforms, French content, the qualification matrix and minimum-version boundaries defined without implicitly adding web, tablet or another language? [Scope, Specification §FR-029, §A19]
- [ ] CHK025 Do accessibility requirements cover voice reading, enlarged text, touch targets, focus, color and animation without claiming certification? [Completeness, Specification §FR-030, §A20]
- [ ] CHK026 Are error, waiting, retained-data and uncertain-outcome states distinguished without inventing a complete offline mode? [Coverage, Specification §FR-008, §FR-031, §A21]
- [ ] CHK027 Does club-logo continuity distinguish associations, files, certain correspondences, unresolved cases and preservation before reset? [Coverage, Specification §FR-032, §A22]
- [ ] CHK028 Does migration scope remain limited to club logos, with F02 identity and F14 transition, without presenting export or migration as completed? [Scope, Specification §FR-032, §Evidence and decision traceability]

## Traceability and limits

- [ ] CHK029 Does every requirement have a scenario and measurable outcome, with V1 sources, statements and approved decisions clearly distinguished? [Traceability, Specification §Inventory coverage, §SC-001–SC-008]
- [ ] CHK030 Are F05/F09/F11/F12/F14 responsibilities and R01/R02 reviews explicit without claiming to complete those scopes or authorize technical planning? [Dependencies, Specification §Cross-feature dependencies, §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Review written requirements, not the success of a future implementation.
- Generated items remain unchecked. `speckit-implement` reads the markers but does not change them.
- The [requirements checklist](requirements.md) has the separate built-in Specify/Clarify lifecycle.
